# vpsie_bare_metal_os (Data Source)

Lists the operating systems a bare-metal server can be installed with in a datacenter, optionally for one hardware plan (GPU plans add GPU-ready images).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vpsie_bare_metal_os" "example" {
  dc_identifier   = "dc-identifier"
  plan_identifier = "plan-identifier"
}

output "linux_images" {
  value = { for os in data.vpsie_bare_metal_os.example.operating_systems : os.identifier => os.name if os.os_family == "linux" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dc_identifier` (String) Identifier of the datacenter.

### Optional

- `plan_identifier` (String) Identifier of a hardware plan, to list the systems that plan can run.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The datacenter identifier, followed by the plan identifier when set.
- `operating_systems` (Attributes List) The installable systems, one entry per version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operating_systems))

<a id="nestedatt--operating_systems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operating_systems`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the image.
- `description` (String) Description of the image.
- `distribution` (String) Distribution the version belongs to, for example `Ubuntu`.
- `gpu` (Boolean) Whether the image carries GPU drivers.
- `identifier` (String) OS identifier (`bmos_...`), for `vpsie_bare_metal.os_identifier`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default version of its distribution.
- `name` (String) Full name, for example `Ubuntu 24.04 LTS`.
- `os_family` (String) `linux` or `windows`.
- `remote_access_configurable` (Boolean) Whether `remote_access` applies to this system.
